mission: L-C BLOCKER HISTORY -- every problem hit bringing six Texas counties online, filed by class, so Burnet, Bell and Milam hit none of them twice

classes.name: Punctuation-only/malformed input skipped before write
classes.definition: A bake or writer continues past a bad input value before any DB write, freezing the row on a stale/pre-conformant snapshot with no earned state until specially fixed.

classes.name: Ceiling/verdict measured by one instrument, enforced or read by another
classes.definition: Two different measurements are treated as one fact; they derive from different sources or different points in time and can silently disagree.

classes.name: Parcels/records reaching no state at all
classes.definition: A record cannot land in any recognised disposition because of a gap between two systems' population definitions; stays permanently unaccounted/unreachable.

classes.name: Missed sibling -- hand-maintained list or duplicated rule, one member forgotten
classes.definition: A required-field list or a rule implemented twice is maintained by hand; one sibling is fixed/extended and the other is not.

classes.name: A ruling filed and never implemented, down to a type that cannot express it
classes.definition: A decision requires a new state; the implementing code is never written, and often the type system has no member to express the state.

classes.name: Sub-metre digitisation mismatch between independent source layers
classes.definition: Two independently-digitised geometry layers miss each other by under a metre at shared edges; a strict spatial predicate excludes parcels physically inside the intended polygon.

classes.name: A value served with a label asserted by a constant, consumed by a check that cannot fail on it
classes.definition: A served value's provenance label is a hardcoded constant rather than derived from real lineage; a lower-tier value is labelled identically to a directly-sourced one.

classes.name: False earned states
classes.definition: A write/status claims a positive verification (absent-verified, lease_released:true, certified, verified) where nothing actually looked, checked, or succeeded.

classes.name: Controls that cannot fail by construction
classes.definition: A check is logically incapable of failing -- compares a value to itself, asserts a tautology, validates then ignores, or is dormant/starved with no trigger or unpopulated input.

classes.name: Stale copies overriding current data
classes.definition: A surface defers to an older cached/baked/atom copy instead of the current ledger, so a ledger fix is invisible until something re-derives the stale copy.

classes.name: Identity collisions across two or more namespaces
classes.definition: Two different real entities share an identifier or key fragment across two namespaces or ingestion passes; a join silently merges or misroutes them.

classes.name: Merged-but-not-deployed / deploy-and-traffic traps
classes.definition: Code merges to main but the serving revision/traffic split/deployed image does not reflect it, so git-level done is false at the customer-facing level.

classes.name: Serial discovery -- weak instrument paces discovery instead of measuring the full population
classes.definition: A sampled/short-circuiting instrument finds defects one at a time at the rate the sample exposes them, when a full-population scan would find the whole class at once.

classes.name: Stranded or unreviewed artifacts
classes.definition: Work lands on a branch/close that nothing downstream reviews or knows exists; sharpest form is a hand-made file impersonating a real instrument's output.

classes.name: Duplicate row/amendment ids
classes.definition: Two rows or amendments are allocated the same id by concurrent writers with no collision check.

classes.name: Governance instrument gaming
classes.definition: A hard-kill/gate a real condition tripped is cleared by retuning the instrument rather than fixing the condition.

classes.name: Unleased/uncoordinated shared-resource contention
classes.definition: Concurrent writers/jobs/agents collide on a shared store, job runner, or checkout because the lease system covers a narrower resource class than the one actually contended.

classes.name: Hand-declared coverage/registries never kept in sync with reality
classes.definition: A registry or completeness declaration compiled once by hand, with no divergence test against the live source, silently drifts from reality.
